status: bounded source/input impact assessment; required fresh validation and independent judgment remain pending
source_reasoning: One allocation-free amount calculation is extracted verbatim from release. The shared is_basic_heal_target predicate now requires the computed signed-range-clamped amount to be positive. It only admits Heal; Damage paths never call this owner. For existing positive Heal the same amount is applied. No field, queue, serializer, source credential, carrier, global action gate, public DTO or cost limit changes. Only ineffective Heal automatic eligibility changes, intentionally correcting F01. New tests cover query/start/release/current stats and old behavioral combinations rerun in final native suites.
